mentions.name: Pacecar
mentions.description: A GitHub App that automatically reviews pull requests by commenting on open PRs and updates, including drafts. It is optimized to be cheap enough to leave on continuously and fast enough that users are not waiting around, addressing PR review as the bottleneck in AI coding workflows.
mentions.problem: The bottleneck in most AI coding workflows is the actual PR review.
mentions.audience: Developers using AI coding workflows who need pull-request reviews
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a GitHub App that reviews PRs. https://pacecar.sh

The bottleneck in most AI coding workflows is the actual PR review, so this just comments on open and update, including drafts.
mentions.author: pacecar
